cards.title: Use the CLI
cards.text: Initialise, build, deploy and serve sites with `@greemo/cli`.
cards.code:
npx @greemo/cli init my-site
npx @greemo/cli build -o dist
npx @greemo/cli deploy
npx @greemo/cli dev

cards.title: Try the AI tools
cards.text: Configure AI, create a site, add a page and export it.
cards.code:
# Configure AI (copy .env.example to .env and add your API key)
cp .env.example .env

# Create a site via CLI
greemo ai create-site --name blog --title "My Blog"

# Add a page
greemo ai add-page --site-path ./sites/blog --page about --content "# About"

# Export to Vue + Vite
greemo export --site ./sites/blog --output ./blog-export
